items.description: Support Multi Selection for Filter Mode
items.detail: The user can select one or many tags to be filter. As for querying in the CLI, they can enter as many tags they'd want to filter and the program would tries its best to match those tags. If one query matches but the other matches multiple then the program would give show a Multi Selection Menu and have the initial selections be those that are matched and those with multiple options will be initially unselected, if you catch my drip.
